mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_question_stat (member_id, question_id, weight, correct_count, wrong_count, last_answered_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{questionId}, GREATEST(1 + #{weightDelta}, 1), #{correctInc}, #{wrongInc}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = GREATEST(weight + #{weightDelta}, 1), correct_count = correct_count + #{correctInc}, wrong_count = wrong_count + #{wrongInc}, last_answered_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_question_stat WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND last_answered_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_question_stat WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND last_answered_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)

SELECT sub.name AS subjectName, ROUND(SUM(s.correct_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.correct_count + s.wrong_count), 0)) AS accuracy FROM member_question_stat s JOIN certification_question q ON q.id = s.question_id JOIN subject sub ON sub.id = q.subject_id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY sub.id, sub.name HAVING SUM(s.correct_count + s.wrong_count) >= 3 ORDER BY accuracy ASC LIMIT 1
